Here, we want to look into `clone_ids` in `{40, 95, 140}`.

Statistics:

1. `family_median_VHH_homology` - Statistic is defined as the VHH's percent homology to the family median VHH.

2. `family_median_CDR3_homology` - Statistic is defined as the CDR3's percent homology to the family median CDR3.

3. `subfamily_median_VHH_homology` - Statistic is defined as the VHH's percent homology to its subfamily median VHH.

4. `subfamily_median_CDR3_homology`- Statistic is defined as the CDR3's percent homology to its subfamily median CDR3.

5. `VHH Homology Order Statistic` - After ordering VHH's by their `family_median_VHH_homology` (in the range 1 to the number of VHHs in the family), the `VHH Homology Order Statistic` can be used to access the VHH observation associated with it.

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
tmp <- read.csv("~/Downloads/S19-Cleaning-Reclustering-Initial-Results.csv", 
                header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

# Imports
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringdist))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggseqlogo))
```

## Group 40

### Family Logo Plot

```{r}
results <- tmp[tmp$clone_id == 40,]

unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(results, "VHH")
unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(results, "junction_aa")

# Pull statistics
median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, echo = F, eval = T}
if (TRUE){
  cat("Group ID: ", paste(unique(substr(results$source_file, 1, 2)),'-',unique(results$clone_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Overall Members: ", nrow(results), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(results$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(results$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
  cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, ' (with ',nrow(results[results$junction_aa == median_CDR3,]), ' CDR3 observations)\n', sep = '')
  cat("Most-frequent VHH: ", median_VHH, '\n', sep = '')
  print(ggseqlogo(as.character(results$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
    theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3, sep = '')))
}
```

### Sub-family Logo Plots

### Ordered by VHH Abundance in Clonal Family

```{r, echo = F, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, eval = T, warning=F}
tab <- top_groups(results, "centroid_id")

for (nm in head(names(tab), 50)){
  tmp_frame <- results[results$centroid_id == as.numeric(nm),]
  
  unrolled_VHHs <- unroll_dupes_fast(results, "VHH")
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(results, "junction_aa")
    
    # Pull statistics
    median_VHH <- names(table(unrolled_VHHs)[order(table(unrolled_VHHs), decreasing = T)][1])
    median_CDR3 <- names(table(unrolled_CDR3s)[order(table(unrolled_CDR3s), decreasing = T)][1])
  
  if (nrow(tmp_frame) > 1){
      cat(paste('Subfamily: ',unique(substr(tmp_frame$source_file, 1, 2)),'-',unique(tmp_frame$clone_id),'-',unique(tmp_frame$centroid_id), sep = ''), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Overall Members: ", sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique VHHs: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$VHH)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Unique CDR3s: ", length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa)), '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent CDR3: ", median_CDR3, '\n', sep = '')
      cat("Most-frequent VHH: ", median_VHH, '\n', sep = '')
      print(ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp_frame$junction_aa), seq_type='aa', method = 'p') + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste(" CDR3 Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", median_CDR3, sep = '')))
  }
}
```

### Cluster Dendrogram (Demanding 2+ VHH Observations for Visualization)

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, echo = F, eval = T}
tmp_res <- results[results$duplicate_count >= 2,]

strings <- tmp_res$VHH

CDR3s <- tmp_res$junction_aa

# Compute the distance matrix using Jaccard distance
dist_matrix <- stringdistmatrix(strings, method = "lv")

# Perform hierarchical clustering
cluster_tree <- hclust(as.dist(dist_matrix), method = "complete")

unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_res, "junction_aa")
consensus_CDR3 <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)

main_title <- paste("Cluster Dendrogram of CDR3 Clonal Family ", tmp_res$clone_id[1], " from: ", gsub("_min_threshold_clone-pass.csv","\n",tmp_res$source_file[1]), "Consensus CDR3: ", consensus_CDR3, "\nDemand >= 2 VHHs, Distance Metric: Levenshtein", sep = '')

par(family = "Courier")


# Plot the dendrogram with labels
plot(cluster_tree, main = main_title, xlab = "VHH Count-Clonal Family-Subfamily-CDR3", sub = NULL, labels = paste(tmp_res$duplicate_count,'-C', tmp_res$clone_id[1], '-', tmp_res$centroid_id,'-',tmp_res$junction_aa, sep = ''), ylab = "Distance (Levenshtein)", cex = 0.75)
```

## Faceted Family/Subfamily Plots

```{r, echo = F, eval = T}
# melt data by centroid_id
dat <- reshape2::melt(results, id.vars = c("centroid_id", "order_index"),
  variable.name = "variable", 
  value.name = "value")

# Subset necessary variables only
dat <- dat[dat$variable %in% c("family_median_VHH_homology",
                               "family_median_CDR3_homology",
                               "subfamily_median_VHH_homology",
                               "subfamily_median_CDR3_homology"#,
                               ),]
```


```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, echo = F, eval = T}
# Create the scatter plot
ggplot(dat, aes(x = order_index, 
                    y = as.numeric(value), 
                    color= factor(centroid_id))) +#,
                    #shape = variable)) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ variable) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.750) +
  scale_color_discrete() +
  #theme_minimal() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "VHH Homology Order Statistic (Decreasing)", y = "Percent Homology") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Subfamily ID:"))
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, echo = F, eval = T}
# Create the scatter plot
ggplot(dat, aes(x = order_index, 
                    y = as.numeric(value), 
                    color= variable)) +#,
                    #shape = variable)) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ centroid_id) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.750) +
  scale_color_discrete() +
  #theme_minimal() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "VHH Homology Order Statistic (Decreasing)", y = "Percent Homology") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Variables (by Subfamily ID):"))
```










































































```{r, echo = F, eval = F}
dat <- tmp[tmp$clone_id == 40,]

# Pull sequences
sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(results$VHH)
# Add names
names(sequences) <- results$sequence_id
# Perform multiple sequence alignment
msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega")
# Store aligned results
results$aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
# Gsub for readability
results$aligned_VHHs <- gsub("-", "_", results$aligned_VHHs)

write.csv(results[,c("order_index",
                     "sequence_id",
                     "clone_id",
                     "centroid_id",
                     "duplicate_count",
                     "family_median_VHH_homology",
                     "family_median_CDR3_homology",
                     "subfamily_median_VHH_homology",
                     "subfamily_median_CDR3_homology",
                     "junction_aa",
                     "VHH",
                     "aligned_VHHs")], 
          file = paste("~/Downloads/S19-Family-",
                       results$clone_id[1],
                       "-",
                       "median-CDR3",
                       "-", 
                       median_CDR3, 
                       "27Mar24.csv", sep = ''), row.names = F)
```
